sequenceReference.note: This is the separately scoped Package B this package's predecessor anticipated: it walks through the src/delivery boundary that planning/gj01-v12-src-adapters-delivery-boundary-authority.json opened but did not itself walk through, scoped narrowly to one framework-neutral request handler — not an HTTP server or ASGI runtime.

goal: Give CreateCustomerCommitService a framework-neutral delivery entry point: CreateCustomerRequestHandler accepts an ordinary CreateCustomer@1 request object, builds the ActionSpec via the generated SDK, runs it through exactly one injected service instance, and maps its outcome to a frozen generic delivery response — no HTTP server, no ASGI runtime.
nonGoals: no HTTP server of any kind
no Postgres, db or schema change
no CI, package.json or dependency change
no release, deploy, readiness or product-runnable claim
no app, module or release/deploy/publish path

red.note: Before src/delivery/create-customer-request-handler.mjs existed, every test importing it failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — a real capability gap, not an environment failure.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the handler's constructor exactness, outcome mapping, or the src/delivery ring materialization it proves drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert src/delivery/create-customer-request-handler.mjs, tests/kernel-create-customer-request-handler.test.mjs, the repository-boundary/substrate/boundary-authority test updates, and this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: delivery-handler-and-tests-only; no adapters, application, domain, db or CI surface touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none: the handler is pure request-in/response-out and performs no I/O of its own

userJourney.before: CreateCustomerCommitService bir müşteri oluşturma isteğini uçtan uca işleyebiliyordu ama onu çağıracak hiçbir framework-nötr giriş noktası yoktu; bir form gönderiminin bu servise nasıl ulaşacağı tanımsızdı.
userJourney.after: Artık CreateCustomerRequestHandler sıradan bir istek nesnesini (requestId, actorId, tenantId, payload, idempotencyKey) kabul edip servisi tam olarak bir kez çağırıyor ve COMMITTED/INVALID/DENY/CROSS_TENANT_DENY sonuçlarını donmuş, framework'ten bağımsız bir 201/400/403 yanıtına eşliyor. Hâlâ hiçbir HTTP sunucusu veya form gönderimi gerçekten çalışmıyor — bu paket yalnızca uygulama ile bir gelecekteki teslimat çerçevesi arasındaki köprüyü kanıtlıyor.
userJourney.note: Hiçbir sunucu, ASGI çalışma zamanı veya framework bu paketle çalışır hale gelmiyor; bu sadece framework-nötr bir işleyicidir.

nextPackage.note: A future, separately scoped package may wire an actual HTTP/ASGI framework around this handler — out of this package's scope and non-goals.
preconditions: this package's targeted GREEN and npm run check both pass
a separate Codex MASTER-approved package scopes the delivery framework decision
